text: The Earth travels around the Sun once each year. Its rotation produces the cycle of day and night.
A triangle has three sides and three angles. In Euclidean geometry, its interior angles add up to one hundred eighty degrees.
The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth. It lies between Asia and Australia on one side and the Americas on the other.
In Python, a dictionary maps keys to values. Square brackets retrieve the value associated with a particular key.
Water can exist as a solid, liquid, or gas. Heating ice melts it into liquid water.
A prime number is a positive integer greater than one with exactly two positive divisors: one and itself.
The heart pumps blood through the circulatory system. Blood carries oxygen and nutrients to tissues throughout the body.
Solar panels convert sunlight into electrical energy. Their output varies with the available sunlight and the orientation of the panels.
To reverse a sequence, read its elements from the final position back to the first. Reversing the result again restores the original order.
A noun can name a person, place, object, or idea. A verb can describe an action or a state.
Sound travels through air as a pressure wave. The frequency of the wave influences the pitch that a listener hears.
The decimal number ten is written as 1010 in binary. Binary notation uses only the digits zero and one.
A museum preserves objects and presents information about them. Exhibitions can help visitors understand history, art, or science.
The Moon reflects sunlight toward Earth. Its visible shape changes as it travels along its orbit.
An email subject line should describe the message clearly. A concise subject helps the recipient decide when to read it.
To find the smallest value in a nonempty list, keep the first value and compare each remaining entry against it.
